name: Atlas
source:
Based on Atlas, who was the primordial Titan who held up the celestial spheres. He is also the titan of astronomy and navigation in the Greek mythology.

She’s been locked away for a long time, waiting for someone to boot her up once more.

”Order acknowledged. Commencing annihilation.”
